decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w6' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8753. Series context: trend strength 1.0 and seasonal strength 0.9999; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.228); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.202.
